Glance 2026.08.18 adds a focused fullscreen preview experience.

## Highlights

- Enter fullscreen directly from the preview window.
- Reveal the title and shortcut bars by moving the pointer to the corresponding screen edge.
- Optionally toggle fullscreen by double-clicking preview content.
